diet.rule_summary: All foods are compatible; only ordinary food quality and variety affect Diet Satisfaction.
Foods containing meat or rendered animal fat are dietary violations. Fish and seafood, plant foods, eggs, honey, and dairy remain compatible.
Foods containing plant ingredients are dietary violations. Meat, fish, eggs, honey, and other animal-origin foods are compatible.
Any meat, fish, egg, honey, dairy, rendered animal fat, or other animal-derived ingredient is a dietary violation; plant-only foods are compatible.
